A '''city''' was located on<ref name="Sanctuary" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Mygeeto DB">{{Databank|mygeeto|Mygeeto}}</ref> [[planet]] [[Mygeeto]]. It was a vast metropolis and featured a [[Unidentified spaceport (Mygeeto)|big spaceport]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], [[Mygeeto Campaign|battles]] had been fought in the [[city]] and heavy [[artillery]] strikes had damaged or destroyed many of it's buildings.<ref name="Sanctuary" /> During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{SanctuaryDate}}</ref> the city was in the state of being repaired. During this time the city's [[spaceport]] was visited by the members of [[Clone Force 99]] and [[Phee Genoa]] on their [[shuttle]] the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']] who were there to pick up two passengers—the fugitives [[Sohi]] and [[Ponder]]—and [[Fuel|refuel]].<ref name="Sanctuary" />

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The city first appeared in the [[2025]] novel ''[[Sanctuary: A Bad Batch Novel]]'', written by [[Lamar Giles]].<ref name="Sanctuary" /> Giles confirmed on [[Wikipedia:Bluesky|Bluesky]] that the city in the novel was meant to be a different one to [[Unidentified Mygeeto city|the one]] featured in the film ''[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith]]''.<ref name="Bluesky">{{Bluesky|username=lamargiles.bsky.social|url=post/3lxpjnmiupk2m|name=[[Lamar Giles]]|date=2025-08-31|quote=hi thanks for reading. i was thinking different city, nothing specific to Ep. III}} {{C|In response to: "@lamargiles.bsky.social, Hello, sorry to bother you, but i just finished reading Sanctuary (great novel btw. i really enjoyed it!) and was wondering. Is the city on Mygeeto in the novel meant to be the same as the one seen in Ep. III or just a different war torn city on the same planet? Thank you!"}}</ref>
